MitoPilot ships taxon-specific curation rulesets for a range of metazoan
clades. The interactive browser below lets you explore them: navigate the
taxonomy tree on the left (scroll, expand, and collapse clades), then select a
highlighted clade to view its curation rules on the right, including the
genetic code, gene-level length/overlap constraints, and start/stop codons.

The taxonomy backbone is built from [NCBI Taxonomy](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/taxonomy).

## Regenerating the browser

The embedded page is a self-contained snapshot. To rebuild it (e.g. after
editing a ruleset), regenerate the asset and rebuild the site:

```r
MitoPilot::ruleset_browser(
  output_file = "pkgdown/assets/ruleset-browser.html",
  open = FALSE
)
pkgdown::build_site()
```

You can also generate a standalone copy for local use at any time:

```r
MitoPilot::ruleset_browser()
```
